title: First-run interactive template — annotated screenshot pack and mini-diagrams
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a focused asset pack for the new template first-run experience used by: in-repo README, web reference app, and the Console quickstart modal. Deliverables: 1) Annotated desktop and mobile screenshots (hero, welcome, model-selection, run/result) with callouts for interactive hotspots and accessibility notes; 2) Mini-diagrams (A/B flow and state transitions) sized for README and the docs header; 3) A compact sprite and export set for docs (PNG 2x, SVG icons, and a 16:9 hero crop); 4) Figma file with component variants and export tokens; 5) A short usage snippet and alt-text table for engineering to wire into the Console quickstart modal. Focus: clarity for first-time users, reduce cognitive load on model selection, and call out predictable fallback behavior for Dedicated/Private variants.
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported in required sizes (desktop 1400x900, mobile 390x844, hero 1280x720) and optimized for web
Figma file with named layers and export presets shared in project folder and linked in PR
Mini-diagrams include state names, transitions, and one sentence intent for each step (max 18 words)
Accessibility checklist included: contrast ratios, keyboard focus state, image alt text table
Design handoff notes added to the GitHub PR and a short demo recorded for the docs owner
